in_game_description: A just recently discovered strangely shimmering ore which cools down rather slowly.
mechanics_text: Only available in the Supernova add-on; can only be mined at Naneroh (closest planet to Ginoya star) — limited time due to gamma radiation.
After the Supernova storyline, only found at Naneroh; skilled players may mine two or three cores per run.
30t (100t on extreme mode) ore can be exchanged for 1 Novanium Core at the Mido Mining Plant in Coromesk (Skavac system).
Used by AMR to manufacture a new series of time-pieces.
